guidances.citation: •Adjusted earnings, excluding reportable catastrophes, per diluted share6, now expected to increase low double digits.

The company continues to expect depreciation expense of approximately $180 million, an effective tax rate of approximately 19 to 21 percent, interest expense of approximately $113 million and amortization of purchased intangible assets of approximately $70 million.
Supported by our strong capital position, we now expect share repurchases of $350 million, while preserving flexibility to invest in attractive growth opportunities across the business
